mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 300) signals a need for aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1400) signals weakening residential construction, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1400, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 300) and elevated interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signals a hawkish monetary policy that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300 AND FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 300), the S&P 500 experiences negative 60-day forward returns due to the expectation of prolonged monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
